Or even just whether today is for listening or resting.'), then the draft 'Could you try this on a smaller scale?'. 'this' keeps the source's referent, the practice that 'Nothing happens' in, anchored by the heading just above it (C02 absent); Emulate's 'it' would have had no anchor right under the heading, so the put-back is right. No new claim, fact, first-person statement or named entity (C03, C04 absent); no 'the kid' (C01 absent). Voice and seam: short, plain and casual, the same register as the paragraph after it; I felt no seam, no tidy summary and no hedge he would not write (the soft 'Maybe' and 'Or even just' in the next paragraph are already in the passage and are not part of this change). D9 is what a one-sentence swap gives (same point, same order), and there is no organization to regenerate in a single question, so accepted. E36/E41 reads 12.5 'you' per 100 words from one 'you' in an eight-word sentence; the source had the same single 'you' (about 8 per 100 in twelve words), the paragraph after it has none, and the guide speaks to the reader as 'you' throughout, so the rate is an artifact of length and is accepted.
